IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'api' AND TABLE_NAME = 'InProcessHisUpdField') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [api].[InProcessHisUpdField]( [ID] [int] IDENTITY(1,1) NOT NULL, [ProcessUid] [uniqueidentifier], [Executionid] [int], Processdatetime datetime, [Object] varchar(50), [ObjectID] int, ItemNumber int, FieldTypeID int, FieldName varchar(500), FieldValue nvarchar(max), LookupValue nvarchar(max), FieldType nvarchar(25), MaxAuditID int null, PreviousValue nvarchar(max), [ReferenceListID] int sparse, CONSTRAINT [PK_InProcessHisUpdField] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ([ID] ASC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.columns WHERE object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'[api].[InProcessHisUpdField]') AND name = 'ReferenceListID') BEGIN alter table [api].[InProcessHisUpdField] add [ReferenceListID] int sparse END
